تستحجبون (form X)
# تَسْتَحْجِبُونَ (tastaḥjibūna) /tas.taħ.d͡ʒi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
# تُسْتَحْجَبُونَ (tustaḥjabūna) /tus.taħ.d͡ʒa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْجَبَ (istaḥjaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
